Busan's star list
finally moved.
slides.subline: Le DORER, Marine City — the city's fourth one-star restaurant, and its first new one since 2024

slides.label: One-MICHELIN-star restaurants in all of Busan — Le DORER became the fourth in 2026
slides.note: MICHELIN Guide Seoul & Busan 2026, announced 5 March 2026 at Signiel Busan · 233 restaurants in the selection, 55 of them in Busan

items.d: Japanese — one star since the first Busan edition in 2024

slides.title:
The first change
came from home.
slides.body:
The MICHELIN Guide added Busan in 2024 and handed out three stars: a Japanese room, a French one, an Italian one. All three kept them in 2025 and again in 2026. For three editions the list did not move.

The restaurant that moved it is the only one on that list cooking Korean. Le DORER runs a tasting menu built on seasonal local ingredients, reading traditional Korean cooking through French and Japanese technique. MICHELIN also gave chef Kim Chang-wook the 2026 Young Chef Award, citing refined simplicity and ingredient integrity.

A port city's first new star went to someone from the port city.

Tasting menus change with the season and hours change without notice, and a newly starred room books out quickly.
Taste is always personal.

caption:
For three years, Busan's Michelin list didn't move.

Le DORER in Marine City became the city's fourth one-star restaurant in the 2026 guide, and chef Kim Chang-wook took the Young Chef Award. Contemporary Korean, tasting menu only.

Menus and hours change — confirm before you go.
